description:
Hits DataForSEO's Content Analysis index to return open-web content (news, blogs, forums, ecommerce, organizations) that mentions a brand/keyword, each tagged positive / negative / neutral. The web-side companion to explore_llm_mentions (AI answers) — together they give full share-of-voice across AI and the open web.

Billing: 25¢ per call — one flat fee whatever the limit. Not billed when nothing is found or the lookup fails.

Inputs:
  site_id — the site to attach the saved report to (required).
  keyword — the brand or keyword to monitor (e.g. "Linear" or "linear.app").
  page_type — optional content vertical: "news", "blogs", "message-boards", "ecommerce", or "organization". Omit to search everything.
  limit — max mentions to sample (default 50, max 1000).

Output: { report_id, url, title, keyword, page_type, total_count, sample_count, sentiment: {positive, negative, neutral}, charged_cents, mentions: [{sentiment, domain, url, title, date_published}] } — mentions lists up to 50 of the sampled pages, negative first; url opens the saved kind="web_mentions" site_report in the dashboard.

Example: { site_id: "…", keyword: "Linear", page_type: "news" }

page_type.description: Content vertical to restrict to. Omit to search all content.

site_id.description: Site to attach the saved report to (site_id from list_sites).

name: explore_web_mentions
title: Scan open-web brand mentions with sentiment
